svg.title: Meridian architecture: documents into the core, the core to a plugin, the plugin to its tool
svg.text: YAML or JSON, one tool each
compile rules say what a layer may set
knows the language, and nothing about any tool

one plugin program per target, spoken to over a private socket

svg.text: A plugin compiles the document into its tool's own files, then drives that tool, as you would by hand. Nothing in the core knows how.
